event: AI-1 writes its prediction and leaves a sentinel on the Danakil block
notes: Ocean from Afar to Turkana; entry at Zula; 60%.

event: First water: Gulf of Tadjoura breaks into Lake Assal
notes: From the east. Seas ~20 m above present.

event: Zula sill fails; Red Sea floods the Danakil
notes: 10000 km2 in a few years. Not yet an ocean.

event: Alid rebuilds the sill; the sea evaporates in a century
Danakil fills and dries eleven times
Afar Gulf becomes permanent; the Danakil block is an island 500 km long
First true oceanic crust on the Erta Ale axis
Caldera eruption buries the Ethiopian rift lakes in ash
Oceanic crust begins forming under Lake Turkana
Sentinel wakes AI-1 on the count: 500 steps
notes: Neither of the other two wake conditions met.
Ocean in Afar right. Northern entry wrong. Continuity to Turkana wrong. Turkana not anticipated.
